items.title: 52222_Marshall Royal oral history interview
items.q: that was the Italian gangsters, the Rizzoto Brothers (PHONETIC)

ctx.x: No, no, that was the Italian gangsters, the Rizzoto Brothers (PHONETIC) and they had enough influence with the police downtown that they could run an after-hour joint upstairs and had an open bar that ran until seven, eight o'clock in the morning, an open bar with mixed drinks of any type that you wanted, just as though it was legitimized. It was run by the Rizzoto Brothers.
There was music up there (inaudible) too?
